FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
TaxWise Solutions specializes in providing individual tax preparation and basic bookkeeping services to clients with straightforward financial needs. Our operations focus on delivering accurate and efficient tax filing assistance, ensuring compliance with all applicable tax laws and regulations. We utilize secure, industry-standard accounting software to safeguard client information, and our team consists of certified professionals, including CPAs and enrolled agents, who stay updated on current tax legislation. Each client engagement is formalized through clear written agreements, establishing mutual understanding of the scope of services and associated fees. Additionally, we conduct regular internal audits of our accounting practices to maintain compliance and uphold high standards of service quality.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not accept clients that provide financial planning or investment advisory services and confirms the exclusion of any clients with a history of tax evasion, fraud, or financial crimes. Additionally, we do not operate with significant international exposure or maintain a multinational client base. All staff hold the appropriate certifications and maintain current licensing to ensure the highest standards of compliance and professionalism.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM; Saturday by appointment only.
